about: What HushOS makes of each fixture in this folder, on the web (apps/web/src/lib/archives/zip-archive.test.ts) and in the core (crates/hushos-core/src/archive.rs). `check` is a preview's rules without its size limit (the ratio counter on); `download` is held to the declared size only. Locked entries are read with `password`. `parts` is how the list splits a path (`/` and `\` both separate; empty and `.` parts dropped). `downloadSha256` pins an entry's bytes; `partsLength` how many parts the list splits a path into (at most 256, deeper paths listed flat); `saveNames` the name a download is saved as. `check` holds an entry to its declared ratio (at most 200:1 once it declares over 1 MiB), not a running one. `count` and `flatFrom` say, for a listing too large to spell out, how many entries it has and from which one on they are listed flat.
